title: Michigan Bigfoot and UFO Sightings 2026 Reported This Year
excerpt: Explore the Bigfoot and UFO sightings reported in Michigan in 2026, including a Class B Bigfoot report and two Tier 2 UFO sightings.
content:
Halloween is right around the corner, and this season has been spookier than most in recent history. No, it's not because it's an election year, but because it has been a huge year for horror and all things that go bump in the night.

From box-office hits like The Backrooms and Obsession to the US government releasing even more UFO files, and to top it off, a new Amazon Prime documentary titled Capturing Bigfoot seems to disprove the famed Patterson-Gimlin footage once and for all. So in honor of this, we're going to explore some reported UFO and Bigfoot sightings in Michigan this year.

Let's start with Bigfoot sightings, then move into UFO sightings.

Michigan Bigfoot Sighting 2026

While the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization has investigated many Bigfoot sightings over the years, including one deemed credible last year, it has investigated only one report in 2026.

READ MORE: Michigan’s Famous 1966 UFO Mystery That Reached Congress

According to the post, the sighting took place on May 19th at dusk. Two sisters were at the very tip of the Upper Peninsula at the Whitefish Lighthouse when the dog began growling at something behind some driftwood. When they turned on the flashlight, they saw Bigfoot duck behind it, then peek back over. The onlookers proceeded to flee. The BRFO investigator gave it a Class B report, since the sighting was only an outline.

Credible UFO Sightings Around Michigan 2026

I've already covered sightings from earlier this year in this post, including two Tier 1 sightings, but now we'll wrap up the second half of the year's sightings. All of these reports were submitted to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC), which logged its 200,000th UFO report earlier this year.

Since June, NUFORC has logged 32 reported UFO sightings, and two are deemed Tier 2 sightings, meaning an object was sighted "exhibiting unusual characteristics such as incredible speed, non-inertial turns, unexplainable propulsion, etc." We'll touch on those two now, but you can read all of the reports across Michigan here.

June 14th, 2026: Monroe, MI

This report was filed by someone who witnessed an object in the sky, both going northbound. However, despite both facing northbound, the driver realized the object in the sky wasn't moving; rather, it was floating in the air. As he passed, it was triangular, with 9 white lights and one red light in the middle. Full report here.

October 8th, 2026: Holly, MI

For 30 seconds on October 8th, this poster noticed a black triangle with three bright lights zooming across the sky. The lights were white, while the object was purple, clearly defined against the sky. The poster opened the Flight Radar 24 app and confirmed that no planes were in the sky. Full report here.

Read about the Bigfoot sightings across Grand Rapids & West Michigan below.

11 Bigfoot Sightings Around West Michigan

Bigfoot is one of the most elusive cryptids. It is a legend seen around the country but has avoided any concrete evidence of its existence. Across multiple counties in West Michigan, there have been around 12 sightings in Kent, Allegan, Muskegon, Kalamazoo, and Ottawa. All this information comes from the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.

Reported UFO Sightings Over Michigan in 2023

More than three dozen UFO reports have been filed in Michigan in 2023, any many of them have purported photographic evidence. While some of these are easily explained away, not all of them are.
